optimizer.initialization: generic INITIAL_PLAN; no reference warm start

ordering: Round-robin attempt index, then seed, then model and mode; alternate model/mode order on odd indices. Batches of four independent attempts, with per-run attempts sequential.
memory: Fresh request messages. No-notes planning input must exactly equal a new target/milk/parameter-guide payload. Current-attempt reflection is generated but discarded. Notes mode carries only its own replacement note. No SDK memory middleware, shared histories, session IDs or previous response IDs. store:false. Gateway-side model routing or memory injection cannot be independently certified by this client.
metrics: Per-attempt pass rate; fraction of seeds ever passed by each budget; best-so-far score mean and sample SD across five seeds. Rejected slots count as zero. Actual per-attempt scores retained. No held-out evaluation.
score: max(0,min(IoU,boundaryF1)-0.25*mean raw foam density in hull(target)-target); quality>=0.7826 plus unchanged IoU, precision, boundary and serving gates.
